text_block_list.text:
On the way back from our outing.
Today, once again, I found myself tagging along
on one of Dream Journey's detours.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well then, today, shall we experience firsthand that there is a "door open only to those who seek knowledge"?

What Dream Journey and I stepped into
was, at first glance, a completely ordinary pool bar.

text_block_list.name: Bar Bouncer
text_block_list.text:
Welcome.
Is this your first time visiting our shop?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Go ahead, Trainer.
Just like I showed you earlier—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Please remember one thing before you go.
It's a special little "good luck charm."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
If they ask if it's your first time, tell them:
"I have returned, guided by the Golden Wings."

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: If asked where that shadow resides—

text_block_list.name: Bar Bouncer
text_block_list.text:
"...Dear customer?
Is this your first time visiting our store?"
choice_data_list: Oh... 'Guided by golden wings, I have returned once more'

text_block_list.name: Bar Bouncer
text_block_list.text: Oh. ...Then where might that shadow be?
choice_data_list: "At the End of the Soaring Journey Through the Sky"!

text_block_list.name: Bar Bouncer
text_block_list.text: Certainly. Please, right this way—

A surge of excitement washes over me as I'm led down the long hallway.
Did anyone else back at that shop
know about the "spell"?
choice_data_list: (So this is the door that opens only to those in the know—!)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Thank you very much. Your information
is always accurate and extremely helpful.

text_block_list.name: Secret Room Resident
text_block_list.text:
"Splendid.
However, Journey, there is one thing I must ask—"

text_block_list.name: Secret Room Resident
text_block_list.text:
"Why did you let an outsider into this room?
You know what happens to those who can't keep a secret, don't you?"

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"Oh dear... This won't do.
Let us retreat for now, Trainer."
choice_data_list: Huh, whaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Pursuers
text_block_list.text: There she is, over there!!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: How persistent. Trainer, this way.
After running all through the nighttime streets and finally shaking off our pursuers, I collapsed into a crouch, totally exhausted.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
"...You look completely pale.
Are you alright, Trainer?"
choice_data_list: What the heck was that...?
What was that...?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I forgot how prone she is to going overboard.
To think she'd even send pursuers after us.
choice_data_list: What happens if I get caught...!?
W-What'll happen if I get caught...!?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: That goes without saying...—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Heh heh heh... Ah, excuse me.
However... Pfft—hahahaha!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I seem to have startled you more than intended.
Please don't worry,
it won't turn into anything serious.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Oh, that was just playing make-believe. You see, my friend tends to be quite a perfectionist about these things.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
He often wants me to tag along with his antics.
He might be a wealthy dilettante,
but deep down, he's just a decent everyday person.
choice_data_list: Oh, here I thought...

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Were you expecting something to happen?
Is that why you look so unsatisfied?
choice_data_list: No, no, there's no way it's not enough—

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: ...Really?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Once upon a time,
you warded off petty evil with the power of knowledge, did you not?

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
On another day, seeking further knowledge,
I took a brief peek into the abyss of intellect.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And today. You learned that the careless use
of knowledge can sometimes even invite danger.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
And so—what do you think?
Have you grown afraid of seeking any more knowledge?
A chill ran down my spine. Being chased around by a massive crowd today was truly terrifying.

I truly, from the bottom of my heart, never want to go through something like that again.
And yet—
choice_data_list: (Even if it's dangerous, I know I'll do it again—)

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu... That is why I warned you.
Follow me, and you will "regret" it—I said.

I bite my lip at her teasing words.
Just how long have I been dancing in the palm of her hand?
Even so—
choice_data_list: Even so, I have no regrets.
Because I'm not scared as long as you're here.
Because I'm not scared as long as you're here
I-If only you'd stopped me harder...!

text_block_list.text:
I bite my lip at her teasing words.
Just how long have I been dancing in the palm of her hand?
Even so—
choice_data_list: Even so, I have no regrets.
Because I'm not scared as long as you're here.
Because I'm not scared as long as you're here
I-If only you'd stopped me harder...!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Indeed.
Once one has tasted true pleasure,
it is terribly difficult to forget it.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
I shall watch over you with high hopes.
As you reach out for the next door—

I couldn't take my eyes off
her delightfully smiling face.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text: Well, well, to think you'd turn to me of all people.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Shall I guide you with full responsibility, then?
At least until the moment you come to a halt, that is.

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
Hahaha...! 
Saying that kind of thing at a time like this?!

text_block_list.name: Dream Journey
text_block_list.text:
You really are adorable.
Don't worry, I'll take all the time
in the world to teach you from here on out.

"She reached her hand out enticingly,
leaving me flustered."
